parsed.visual_overview: A young man and a sleek AI robot sit opposite each other in a train compartment. The robot corrects his English mistakes and explains the app's features using UI overlays. The ad ends with a call to action and an app download animation.

scenes.script_native:
Miss Nova says: कहाँ travel कर रहे हैं आप?
Rahul says: I, going Goa!
Miss Nova says: आपको बोलना चाहिए "I am going to Goa", या फिर "I am heading to Goa".
Rahul says: ओह, अच्छा? पर मैं ऐसी English बोलना कैसे सीखूँ?
scenes.script_roman:
Miss Nova says: Kahan travel kar rahe hain aap?
Rahul says: I, going Goa!
Miss Nova says: Aapko bolna chahiye "I am going to Goa", ya phir "I am heading to Goa".
Rahul says: Oh, achha? Par main aisi English bolna kaise seekhun?

scenes.script_native: Miss Nova says: मेरे साथ रोज़ बस 10-15 minutes speaking practice कीजिए। मैं सब कुछ Hindi में समझाऊँगी, और आप just 30 days में improve कर लेंगे।
scenes.script_roman: Miss Nova says: Mere saath roz bas 10-15 minutes speaking practice kijiye. Main sab kuch Hindi mein samjhaungi, aur aap just 30 days mein improve kar lenge.

scenes.script_native:
Rahul says: पर ये सब तो बहुत expensive होगा ना?
Miss Nova says: बिल्कुल नहीं, ये offline coaching से सात गुना सस्ता है।
scenes.script_roman:
Rahul says: Par yeh sab toh bahut expensive hoga na?
Miss Nova says: Bilkul nahi, yeh offline coaching se saat guna sasta hai.

scenes.script_native:
Miss Nova says: और 1 crore+ लोग already मेरे साथ practice कर रहे हैं।
Rahul says: Super! मैं अभी download करता हूँ!
Miss Nova says: तो अभी Supernova AI download कीजिए।
scenes.script_roman:
Miss Nova says: Aur 1 crore+ log already mere saath practice kar rahe hain.
Rahul says: Super! Main abhi download karta hoon!
Miss Nova says: Toh abhi Supernova AI download kijiye.

pitch_points_used: Time is not the blocker (10-15 minutes)
